recipes.name: help
recipes.doc: Show the recipes, or the options of one: just help <recipe>

options.name: RECIPE
options.help: The one recipe whose options to show

recipes.name: init
recipes.doc: Set up this checkout, then ask for what a first deploy needs

options.name: ADDRESS
options.help: The Proxmox host's address, for its hosts.yml

options.name: ON
options.help: Set up another host of this checkout, by its name (just host lists them); a value with a dot or a colon is taken for --address through 2.x

options.name: TOKEN_USER
options.help: The API token's user, when it is not ansible@pve

options.name: TOKEN_ID
options.help: The API token's ID, the part after its user's !, when it is not ansible

options.name: TOKEN_SECRET_FILE
options.help: A file holding the token's secret (or AGENT_WAREHOUSE_TOKEN_SECRET in the environment; never on the command line)

options.name: GITHUB_USER
options.help: The GitHub account whose repositories are cloned

options.name: STORAGE
options.help: The storage for VM disks, for local.yml: written when the token can use it there

options.name: BRIDGE
options.help: The bridge the template is built on, for local.yml (before the template exists)

options.name: TAILSCALE
options.help: Answers init's VPN question: on, each VM joins your tailnet; off, none - a VPN of yours that routes the LAN, or none at all (vpn in local.yml)

options.name: CERTIFICATE
options.help: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate to check the API against, as the host prints it (openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256): kept, or put in place of one that changed, only when it is that one

options.name: PROMPT
options.help: Ask nothing, even at a terminal

options.name: EXTRA
options.help: Nothing: any word after the options is refused, unsaid

recipes.name: install
recipes.doc: Install the locked Python packages and the Galaxy collections: into your virtualenv, or this checkout's own

options.name: LOCK
options.help: Update uv.lock after editing a pin in pyproject.toml, installing nothing (uv from PATH)

recipes.name: vault
recipes.doc: Encrypt the vault, or edit it once it is encrypted

options.name: ON
options.help: That host's own vault, which holds its token, rather than the shared one (just host lists them)

recipes.name: deploy
recipes.doc: Create, configure and sign in the VM(s), then open them in your editor

options.name: STAGE
options.help: Run one stage and nothing after it: template (the cloud-init template, if missing), provision (create and start), configure (every tagged VM, unless named) or ssh-config (refresh the SSH aliases; without names, also prune those of VMs that are gone)

options.name: CHECK
options.help: Dry-run configuration: ansible-playbook --check --diff (every tagged VM, unless named)

options.name: ON
options.help: Run against this host rather than the current one (just host lists them)

options.name: ROLES
options.help: Configure only these roles, comma-separated: beside VM names it means --only configure (just deploy alpha --tags claude_code)

options.name: START
options.help: Start a VM this run would leave stopped (proxmox_vm_start_existing)

options.name: CORES
options.help: Each new VM's vCPU cores, in place of the vm_cores setting

options.name: MEMORY
options.help: Each new VM's memory: MiB, or 16G, in place of the vm_memory_mb setting

options.name: DISK
options.help: Each new VM's root disk, as 64G or 1T, in place of the vm_disk_size setting

options.name: REPOS
options.help: Only these of your GitHub repositories on each VM named, comma-separated, in place of the github_projects setting: kept for that VM, and added to by a later --repos

options.name: NAMES
options.help: The VMs; none means agent-warehouse-default, or every VM this project created for --only configure, --check and --only ssh-config

recipes.name: code
recipes.doc: Open a VM in your editor, VS Code by default, with Claude on the VM and this machine's recent Claude sessions copied there

options.name: PROJECT
options.help: Open one project folder on the VM rather than the whole projects directory

options.name: IDE
options.help: Open it in this editor for this run, rather than the one the editor setting names: vscode or zed

options.name: ON
options.help: Run against this host rather than the current one (just host lists them)

options.name: SESSION
options.help: Continue one of this machine's Claude Code sessions there, by its ID as /resume lists it: its checkout brought to the session's pushed commit, ready for claude --resume

options.name: NAME
options.help: The one VM to open

recipes.name: login
recipes.doc: Sign the VM(s) in to Claude, GitHub and Tailscale, or report how each is signed in

options.name: ON
options.help: Run against this host rather than the current one (just host lists them)

options.name: SIGN_IN
options.help: One sign-in: claude (by the browser, then Remote Control), github (the device flow, then the private repositories) or tailscale (its web login)

options.name: NAMES
options.help: The VMs to sign in, one after another; none reports every VM this project created

recipes.name: status
recipes.doc: What every VM this project created is doing, and what needs doing next, read without changing anything

options.name: ON
options.help: Run against this host rather than the current one (just host lists them)

options.name: ONLY
options.help: Only these sections, comma-separated: vms storage capacity access sign-ins system work; vms, storage and capacity read only the Proxmox API, never a VM

options.name: JSON
options.help: The report as JSON, alone on standard output, with the same exit code

options.name: NAMES
options.help: Only these VMs; none reads every VM this project created

recipes.name: settings
recipes.doc: Each setting's value and where it was set, for a role, a variable or all of them; --value sets one in local.yml, --reset puts it back

options.name: ALL
options.help: Every setting of local.yml, and which secrets of vault.yml are set

options.name: CHANGED
options.help: Only what local.yml or vault.yml changes from the defaults; alone, all of it

options.name: JSON
options.help: The report as JSON, alone on standard output

options.name: ON
options.help: That host's values rather than the current host's; beside --value or --reset, its own local.yml is the one changed

options.name: RESET
options.help: Put the one setting named back to its default: its line out of local.yml, its example's back

options.name: VALUE
options.help: Set the one setting named to this value, in local.yml (never a secret: just vault; an empty value is none: --reset)

options.name: NAME
options.help: A role (tailscale) or one variable or setting (tailscale_ssh); none shows how to use this

recipes.name: destroy
recipes.doc: Save the VM(s)' own Claude sessions here, release them from Claude, GitHub and Tailscale, then delete them

options.name: CONFIRM
options.help: Delete without asking, these VMs only: the same names as given, comma-separated

options.name: ON
options.help: Run against this host rather than the current one (just host lists them)

options.name: NAMES
options.help: The VMs; none means agent-warehouse-default

recipes.name: host
recipes.doc: List the hosts, or make one the current host, which every command runs against unless --host names another

options.name: JSON
options.help: The list as JSON, alone on standard output

options.name: REMOVE
options.help: Delete the host's folder in hosts/, after you type its name: its VMs and their SSH aliases stay

options.name: VMS
options.help: With --json: the VMs a run would name, comma-separated, to say which host it would reach

options.name: ON
options.help: With --json: the host a run would be given, to say which host it would reach

options.name: NAME
options.help: The host to make the current one: every command runs against it from now on

recipes.name: logs
recipes.doc: List the run logs in .logs/, newest first

recipes.name: mcp
recipes.doc: Let Claude Code sessions in any project run these commands, through an MCP server

options.name: ANY_BRANCH
options.help: Let the server run this checkout on any branch, or with tracked changes; without it, main with no tracked change only

options.name: SCREEN
options.help: Whether someone is at this machine's screen for the sign-ins: 1, as for Claude Desktop, or 0; unset, the server decides per session

options.name: BROWSER
options.help: What opens the sign-in pages for the runs it starts, when the default does not (BROWSER)

options.name: PROJECT_DIR
options.help: Register it for this one project's folder only (Claude Code's local scope), not for every project

options.name: REMOVE
options.help: Take the server out of Claude Code again

options.name: SHOW
options.help: Print the command, and an entry for Claude Desktop, and register nothing

options.name: VAULT_PASSWORD_FILE
options.help: Where the vault's password is, when it is not this checkout's .vault_pass

options.name: EXTRA
options.help: Nothing: any word after the options is refused
